attributes.title: Mail Flow Overview (Postfix + Exchange) - Local + EXAMPLE Cluster (may be slow)
attributes.description: Postfix (logs-postfix@custom), Exchange Online Message Trace and Exchange Server message tracking from the local cluster and the EXAMPLE remote cluster (cross-cluster search). Every panel also queries EXAMPLE, so it can respond slowly, and if EXAMPLE is down or slow its data is skipped or partial.
